name.ja: HG 1/144 プチッガイ きゃらっがい サラ

description.ja: 『ガンダムビルドダイバーズ』よりヒロインのサラがきゃらっがいになって登場！
description.en: From "Gundam Build Divers", the heroine Sarah appears as a character!

description.ja: • フェイスパーツは優しい表情と笑顔の選択式。
description.en: • Face parts include a selection of gentle expressions and smiles.

description.ja: • 頭部パーツは差し替え式でプチッガイも再現可能！
description.en: • The head parts are replaceable, allowing you to recreate Petitgguy!

description.ja: • 後ろ髪は別パーツでかわいらしく可動！
description.en: • The back hair is a separate part and is cutely movable!

description.ja: • 他のきゃらっがいと連結可能な台座付き！
description.en: • Comes with a pedestal that can be connected to other Charagguys!

accessories.ja: 差し替えフェイスパーツ×1
